_purpose: Provenance binding for the per-session summary capture: job id ↔ executed query text ↔ committed SQL file ↔ result file. Source: `bq show -j --format=prettyjson <job_id>` on 2026-09-03. NOT an identity source: tools/check_full_demo.py takes user_email only from bq_jobs_identity.json (INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_BY_USER) and cross-checks this file against it.
executed_query:
-- Row and tool-call count per session in agent_events (read-only aggregate, no row pull).
-- Substantiates "212 rows, 4 sessions" on the page; the page pulls three of the four sessions.
--   bq query --use_legacy_sql=false --project_id=test-project-0728-467323 < sessions_summary.sql
SELECT session_id, agent,
       COUNT(*)                                  AS rows_in_table,
       COUNTIF(event_type = 'TOOL_COMPLETED')    AS tool_completed,
       MIN(timestamp)                            AS t0,
       MAX(timestamp)                            AS t1
FROM `test-project-0728-467323.okf_rfc_demo.agent_events`
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY t0;
normalization: strip `-- ` comments, collapse whitespace, strip trailing semicolon
consumer: app.js FILES.summary → D.summary (D.tableRows, D.fourth) → ids strip 'not pulled' chip and '<n> in the table' status
